gloss: school closure; closing of a school

definitions.gloss: school closure; closing down a school
definitions.explanation: The permanent closing of a school, usually because enrolment has fallen too low to keep it running. Also used with する as a verb.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}{閉校|へいこう}になる。
examples.english: It will be closed down next year.

examples.japanese: {生徒|せいと}が{減|へ}り、{閉校|へいこう}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: With the number of students falling, the school's closure was decided.

examples.japanese: {百年|ひゃくねん}{以上|いじょう}の{歴史|れきし}を{持|も}つ{小学校|しょうがっこう}が{今年度|こんねんど}{末|まつ}で{閉校|へいこう}する。
examples.english: An elementary school with over a hundred years of history will close at the end of this school year.

notes:
{閉|へい} (close) + {校|こう} (school). Refers to a school shutting down for good, not to the end of a school day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉校|へいこう}する: to close down (of a school)
- {閉校|へいこう}になる: to be closed down
- {閉校|へいこう}{式|しき}: closing ceremony held when a school shuts down
- {少子化|しょうしか}による{閉校|へいこう}: closure due to the falling birth rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {廃校|はいこう}: closed school — emphasizes the abolished school itself, often the disused building
- {休校|きゅうこう}: temporary closure — classes suspended for snow, illness, etc., with the school still in operation
- {閉店|へいてん}: store closing — the same {閉|へい} used of shops
